pylons_vi: 3 tháp chữ H, 1 dầm ngang trên; dây văng màu cam; giữa ≈99,7 m, hai bên 94,5 m
pylons_en: 3 H-shaped pylons with one upper cross-beam; orange stays; centre ≈99.7 m, sides 94.5 m

pylon_custom.description: H pylons: two square vertical legs just outside the deck, a steel-looking cross-beam at ≈60% of the above-deck height, an under-deck beam, legs straight to the pile cap. Two planes of orange-sheathed stays in a semi-fan from the leg tops above the upper beam.

model3d.notes: Deck-level Commons photo shows the upper cross-beam; the Báo Lâm Đồng aerial shows orange stays and 3 pylons.
